measured.method: unWISE time-resolved epochs (W1+W2, native WCS), centroid_2dg, WLS fit of position + proper motion + parallax, 3-sigma clipping, 1000x bootstrap

reference.source: Gaia DR3 6412596012146801152 (eps Ind B, Ba+Bb photocentre)

template.name: Blackbody 1100 K (T1+T6 brown-dwarf pair, ~1300 K + ~900 K), scaled at 4.4–4.9 µm — for comparison only

notes: 461 SPHEREx images; 324 clean measurements used (forced PSF fit of the target and its catalogue neighbours on IMAGE − ZODI, position propagated to each image date).
20 images were left out because a catalogue star was closer than 9" to the moving target (one SPHEREx pixel is 6.15"; such blends cannot be separated).
Peaks at 1.1–1.3, 1.6 and 2.1 µm (water absorption in between), a deep methane band at 3.2–3.5 µm (11.06 ± 0.13 mJy) and the brightest window at 3.9–4.2 µm (58.81 ± 0.55 mJy).
The methane band is at 19 % of the 4 µm peak and the flux drops again at 4.4–4.9 µm (19.20 ± 0.18 mJy; carbon monoxide): the classic shape of a T dwarf.
Ba and Bb (0.7" apart) are blended in SPHEREx's 6" pixels: this is their combined spectrum.
A 1100 K blackbody (dashed) does not fit: molecules (water, methane, CO) carve deep bands into the spectrum.
spectrum.method: SPHEREx L2 cutouts, IMAGE−ZODI; forced EPSF fit of target + Gaia/CatWISE neighbours + constant within 4 px (aperture r=2 px fallback), VARIANCE errors, blends < 1.5 px flagged, per-pixel wavelength from WCS-WAVE (quick-look), moving position per image

copilot.en: ε Indi B is a pair of brown dwarfs (types T1 and T6) that orbit the star epsilon Indi A, about 12.1 light-years away. In 46 WISE images over 14 years we measured that it moves 4.72 arcseconds per year; the ESA Gaia DR3 catalogue gives 4.68, a 99.0 % agreement. The pair also moves like its star epsilon Indi A to 99.3 %, showing that they travel through space together. Its SPHEREx spectrum shows deep water and methane bands, the classic shape of a T dwarf. In the movie, watch a dot move down and to the left (south-east) by about 66 arcseconds between 2010 and 2024.
copilot.az: ε Indi B epsilon Indi A ulduzunun ətrafında fırlanan iki qəhvəyi cırtdandan (T1 və T6 tipli) ibarət cütdür, bizdən təxminən 12,1 işıq ili uzaqdadır. 14 il ərzindəki 46 WISE şəklində onun ildə 4,72 qövs saniyəsi hərəkət etdiyini ölçdük; ESA-nın Gaia DR3 kataloqu 4,68 verir, uyğunluq 99,0 %-dir. Cüt öz ulduzu epsilon Indi A ilə də 99,3 % eyni hərəkət edir: deməli, onlar kosmosda birlikdə səyahət edirlər. SPHEREx spektrində su və metanın dərin udulma zolaqları görünür, bu, T tipli cırtdanın klassik formasıdır. Filmdə bir nöqtənin 2010-cu ildən 2024-cü ilə qədər təxminən 66 qövs saniyəsi aşağı və sola (cənub-şərqə) getməsinə baxın.
